notes.title: Patch 1.0.1.3 Is Live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The second patch for Chains of Fury is now live - we've managed to fix some really unpleasant issues and crashes connected to the save/load system, as well as problems with colliders in two of the levels. 

[h2]Change Log:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a confirmation prompt for deleting saves
[*] Fixed a crash when max save count reached
[*] Fixed issues when spaming quick load
[*] Locked save during Fury mode
[*] Changed art for health pickups
[*] Fixed colliders in level 1 and level 5
[/list]

Rest assured, we are working on even more updates and fixes, and we'll keep diligently analyzing the feedback you provide - if you encounter any bugs or issues while you're playing Chains of Fury, please, report them here on Steam, or even better, come join our [url=https://discord.gg/zbrWRNSCTP]Discord Server[/url] - we might have follow-up questions and having an actual conversation is easiest there. If you really want to help us fix as many bugs as we can, include as much details as possible - your logs are especially helpful. You can find them in the following folder:

C:\Users\%username%\AppData\LocalLow\CobbleGames\ChainsOfFury

Just archive the contents of the folder and upload it to Dropbox or any other file-sharing platform and share the link with us, please.

But you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/zbrWRNSCTP]Discord[/url] not just to report bugs, but even to hang out with us and other fans of the game, we will be happy to see you!

Now, let's go kick some doors in, shall we?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1121320/Chains_of_Fury/

notes.title: Another Patch in Progress - Keep the Feedback Coming!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

We are thrilled to see how many of you have played Chains of Fury since the release of its Volume I on Monday. We are also extremely grateful for all the feedback you have given us so far, and would like to ask you to keep it coming.

We are aware there are bugs still plaguing the game, but we are working on improving its technical state - we have [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1121320/view/4676514574278744887]released a patch yesterday[/url] already, and we are testing another one as we speak - which will fix several problems with saving and loading the game, as well as erroneous colliders in levels 1 and 5.

If you encounter any bugs or issues while you're playing Chains of Fury, please, report them here on Steam, or even better, come join our Discord Server - we might have follow-up questions and having an actual conversation is easiest there. If you really want to help us fix as many bugs as we can, include as much details as possible - your logs are especially helpful. You can find them in the following folder:

C:\Users\%username%\AppData\LocalLow\CobbleGames\ChainsOfFury

Just archive the contents of the folder and upload it to Dropbox or any other file-sharing platform and share the link with us, please.

Thank you for helping us make Chains of Fury an even better game!

notes.title: Patch Patch 1.0.1.2 Is Out Now
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Chains of Fury launched just a few days back, but we are already hearing positive comments about it, which we are tremendously grateful for! Please, keep the feedback coming - ideally write a review here on Steam, it helps more than you think!

We immensely appreciate constructive criticism as well however, and we are working hard to address all of the reported issues - we have already released a patch today, squishing some of the bugs that have been pestering you. Rest assured, this is by far not the last update, as we'll keep diligently analyzing the feedback you, our beloved players, provide, and doing our best to fix any issues you encounter.

If you wish to hang out with us and with the rest of community, you are cordially invited to join our [url=https://discord.gg/zbrWRNSCTP]Discord[/url] - the best place to share your bug reports and suggestions!

notes.title: Demo version 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Demo version 1.0.4 (d03m03y2021)

One can find the full changelog and discussion in the link below:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1121320/discussions/0/3003299213522818888/

We are slowly rebuilding the foundation and getting ready to add more content. Since the publisher representative already revealed the secret - There will be a Kickstarter campaign starting soon. The demo will stay here but ... if you decide to back us up one of the prizes will be access to things that will not be included in this demo. At some point, we will have to stop developing the demo and move on to the full dev. More about the game future in the separate thread.

Here's what's new in this version

New:

- Added new enemy - Psyborg. The enemy is now in a basic AI form but later it will act as a sniper unit.
- you can now play with a gamepad and reconfigure the controls in the control menu (* there is one bug described below)
- new battle music, enviro and UI sounds

Fixed
- Ladders should be more comfortable to use. Now you can move up and down the ladder and if you press the jump button then you can jump off the ladder.

Changed
- removed Minimap - why? It has to do with the full version. You will be able to add a minimap as a usable item after you find it on the level. In the full version, Player will be allowed to carry 4 items in total including weapons, armor or any extra items. You will only be able to modify your setup in the safe zone after you leave the level alive. More about the safe zone (or Loadout) in a separate thread.

notes.title: Demo Version 0.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2] Demo version 0.5 (d29.m11.y2020)[/h2]
One can find full changelog and discussion in link below:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1121320/discussions/0/3003299213522818888/
[h3]New Features:[/h3]

[b]- Enemy and Exit Markers:[/b]
You will now see a marker if an enemy is nearby. It might change later on to be something temporary. I was thinking to have it activated during fury mode (when you hear the aggressive metal). We'll see. Exit marker now available if you are within 60 meters of range. This will also change later on when we will be changing level layout.

[b]- Objectives:[/b]
You will now see mission main objectives. The demo contains now only two of them - kill all enemies and find exit. Later we will add more.

[b]- Secrets[/b]
Some of you might have found a pig sitting on a toilet. Places like that will be considered secrets. For now I've added only one such secret marker but later this will be expanded with more such places and interactions. This will also be improved in the future with some dialogues and other stuff. We want to reward you for exploring the level. The level will change after I get all the planned features implemented.

[b]- Walking animation and Weapon Sway[/b]
This was an easy thing to do so I've added a simple weapon sway feature and animation while you walk. It adds a bit of a juice.

[b]- New models for Ammo, HP and Armor[/b]

[h3]Fixed Issues:[/h3]
- Brawler Pig HP bar was not refreshing. This is fixed now.
- Enemies did not drop any loot when got killed by enviro. This is fixed now.

[h2]What's next?[/h2]

[b]- Summary screen showing you objectives completion
- Better AI.
- Items
- Load out section (Equip items, armor and weapon, spend skill points)[/b]

When this is done the level will get an overhaul.
The goal is to make it suitable for better exploration and a boss fight.
Each level will have an exit and a boss arena. Boss will be very tough, probably impossible to kill during the first run (unless you are hardcore). If you leave the level alive then you will be able to keep all the items and weapons with you and bring whatever you choose with you for the next run. Sort of looter - shooter approach. At least this is the plan for the future.
